ownership.quote: Crusoe, the industry's first vertically-integrated AI infrastructure provider, today announced the initial closing of its anticipated $3.9 billion Series F funding round, at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation.

stage.quote: Crusoe Raises $3.9 Billion Series F for its Vertically-Integrated AI Infrastructure Platform
stage.note: Last priced round is a Series F (Sept 2026, initial closing); an interim Series E (~$1.375B, Oct 2025) preceded it per Sacra.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sacra estimate: 'Crusoe (~$7B+ raised across equity and credit, at a >$10B valuation following its October 2025 Series E)', dated before the Series F closing; does not yet include the new $3.9B Series F.
total_funding_usd.quote: Crusoe (~$7B+ raised across equity and credit, at a >$10B valuation following its October 2025 Series E)

last_round.quote: The oversubscribed round was co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners, alongside significant backing from new and existing investors including Founders Fund, GIC, NVIDIA, Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), Radical Ventures, and TPG.

revenue.quote: Sacra estimates Crusoe hit $276M in revenue in 2024, up 82% YoY, driven by explosive growth in its GPU cloud operations. Crusoe projects that it will grow revenue to ~$500M in 2025.

note: Crusoe pivoted from flared-gas Bitcoin mining to a vertically-integrated AI infrastructure/cloud provider (data centers, power generation, GPU cloud). Raised a $600M Series D at $2.8B valuation (Dec 2024, led by Founders Fund), a ~$1.375B Series E at >$10B valuation (Oct 2025, co-led by Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners, per Sacra), and a $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation (initial closing announced Sept 2026). Also uses substantial project debt/credit facilities (e.g. Upper90, Brookfield, Victory Park Capital, and large data-center project financing with JPMorgan/Blue Owl) separate from equity rounds.
